resources.string: Take turns drawing a secret word. The drawer taps their name, picks one of three pictures, then presses and holds to see the word. Everyone else looks away.
Draw with your finger. Pick from six colours and three brushes, and use Undo, Clear or the Eraser. No drawing skills needed: stick figures are fine.
Think you know it? Tap your name to buzz in. The clock stops, and you get one go: tap the matching picture card, or type the word in the older-player mode.
A right guess scores for the guesser and the drawer, more the faster it comes and the trickier the word. A wrong guess sits you out for the turn.
Everyone draws once per round. With four, six or eight players you can play two teams: only the drawer\'s team guesses. Same screen only: there is no Nearby or Online mode.
Pictionary-style games work because a rough picture only needs to be good enough to remind someone of a word, which is why quick sketches often beat careful ones.
